add.event: 国会通过1862年法定货币法，允许发行1.5亿美元绿背纸币
add.evidence: Congress approved the Legal Tender Act of 1862, allowing the issue of $150 million in national notes known as greenbacks

add.event: 1864年法案使联邦政府开始积极监管商业银行
add.evidence: The 1864 act, based on a New York State law, brought the federal government into active supervision of commercial banks.

add.event: 新法案对州银行券征收10%的税，自1866年7月1日生效
add.evidence: A later act, passed on March 3, 1865, imposed a tax of 10 percent on the notes of state banks to take effect on July 1, 1866.

add.event: 州银行数量由1863年的1466家减至247家
add.evidence: the number of state banks dwindled from 1,466 in 1863 to 247 in 1868.
